appropriate_uses: Persian and English regional reporting as a lead for Iranian, Yemeni, Gulf, and diaspora-facing claims.
geography: Iranian diaspora and Middle East region
inappropriate_uses: Treating reported official claims or anonymous sourcing as direct proof, or counting translated versions as separate chains.
known_failure_modes: Diaspora editorial stance; translation and summarization drift; reliance on opposition, official, or anonymous sources can require lineage separation.
name: Iran International
observables: Persian and English reporting, official-source claims, regional statements, and opposition or diaspora perspectives
originating_chain_rule: Persian and English Iran International editions, updates, and republications of one report remain one originating chain unless independently sourced reporting is documented.

review_history.note: Added after source-ID hygiene audit found Iran International evidence incorrectly routed through Anadolu.
